-   Document AI-assisted code in a reproducible pipeline
-   Using AI as a programming assistant rather than as an autonomous agent

## Key takeaways

AI can accelerate implementation, but cannot replace scientific reasoning. It can also decelerate implementation if not adopted critically.
Every transformation should be transparent, reproducible, and independently validated.
Responsibility for the code and resulting dataset lies with the researcher.
